title: Software Engineer I
description_preview:
Overview
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
What We're Looking For
The Software Engineer I analyzes, designs, develops, and maintains software solutions for the organization’s products and systems. Collaborates on system integrations across software, firmware, and hardware to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and program consistency. Develops, validates, and tests software structures, automated tooling, user documentation, and core functionality. Work is reviewed for accuracy and adherence to established processes and guidelines.
Essential Duties And Responsibilities
Completes all phases of software engineering design projects, including coding, debugging, testing, and deployment
Collaborates with immediate and cross-functional team members to establish requirements, participate in code reviews, and build productive working relationships
System Integration & Optimization: Serves as a key link between hardware and software, ensuring firmware and on-device software interact seamlessly with target hardware through data-driven performance analysis and feedback
Intelligent Root Cause Analysis: Develops automated scripts, data analysis workflows, and tools to identify system performance anomalies and accelerate root-cause analysis on complex integration issues
AI Tooling & Methodology: Actively explores, builds, and adopts modern AI-assisted development tools and machine learning methodologies to enhance engineering workflows and data analysis
Conducts analysis of processes and systems, interpreting results and recommending potential solutions for software and system improvements
Contributes to the development and testing of software solutions for various products, ensuring they meet quality, performance, and adherence standards
Creates and maintains project documentation, including source code comments, design specifications, and test results
Exercises sound judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate actions for problem-solving and solution delivery
Stays up to date with emerging technologies, AI/ML tools, and software engineering methodologies, applying them to projects as needed.
This position requires hybrid work (3 days/week in office) in the Holtsville, NY office.
This position is expected to start in January 2027.
Required Qualifications
Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or related field
Relevant experience (academic projects, internships or industry experience) in software development or a related field
Equivalency: Equivalent practical work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree
Preferred Qualifications
Successful completion of a Zebra Technologies Internship
Hands-on proficiency with core programming languages (e.g., C, C++, Python, or Java)
Demonstrated experience applying AI/ML concepts or tools to solve practical problems (via academic coursework, internships, or substantial personal projects)
Familiarity with data analysis and machine learning libraries/frameworks (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or OpenCV)
Exposure to low-level systems, embedded platforms, firmware, or hardware-software interfacing
Familiarity with software development life cycles (Agile/Scrum), modern version control (Git), and automated CI/CD practices
Strong quantitative, analytical, problem-solving, and written/verbal communication skills.
Position Specific Information
Travel Requirements: Up to 15%

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability and protected veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
